steps.name: Set up job
Run actions/checkout@v4
Run actions/setup-python@v5
Run python -m pip install . 'pytest>=8,<10' 'pytest-asyncio>=1,<2'
Run python -m pip install postgresql-binaries==16.15.0
Run python -m pip install pgserver==0.1.4

Run python -m pytest -q tests/test_native_bundle_build.py tests/test_windows_profile_access.py tests/test_native_bundle.py tests/test_native_snapshot.py tests/test_native_resources.py tests/test_build_identity.py tests/test_local_profile.py::test_empty_lock_file_needs_no_write_before_exclusion tests/test_local_profile.py::test_cross_process_lock_times_out_and_can_be_reused tests/test_local_profile.py::test_nested_locks_and_helpers_are_reentrant
Download an existing owned candidate for isolated verification
Build portable vector against the pinned public PostgreSQL distribution
Build portable Windows vector with the Visual Studio toolchain
Verify relocated tools, legacy upgrade, vector indexes and backup restore
Verify the installed supplier and packaged native cache without executing its wrapper
Verify offline snapshot, actual native upgrade and original-engine staged rollback
Verify Linux root and service-account ownership through snapshot and rollback
Export only the root qualification summary for the artifact worker
Diagnose fresh Windows initialization after an actual failure
Run actions/upload-artifact@v4
Post Run actions/setup-python@v5
Post Run actions/checkout@v4
Complete job
